description:
Seol, a former member of the violent gang Mimanpa, lives as ‘Snow’ in the so-called ‘Black Suit Gang’ led by Yong, after reuniting with him in prison following his sentence. Despite his delicate appearance, Seol has no interest whatsoever in the world around him. Handsome, who persistently fixates on him, was nothing but an annoying and irritating guy. For over a year, the Black Suit Gang evaded police pursuit with ease, enjoying unstoppable success. One day, acting on intelligence brought by Yong, they decide to rob a rural bank vault. It seemed like a foolproof job. But once inside the vault, their comrades go silent. Inside the vault, rumored to hold a chaebol family's hidden slush fund, Seol ends up seeing ‘Handsome's’ hidden face...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
